definition: The practice of tracking and managing changes to prompts over time, similar to how source code is version-controlled.
details: Prompt versioning allows teams to test, roll back, and audit changes to prompts used in production, treating prompts as a first-class engineering artifact rather than an informal, untracked text string.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. Boil it down and it is this: The practice of tracking and managing changes to prompts over time, similar to how source code is version-controlled. Here is why it matters: Prompt versioning allows teams to test, roll back, and audit changes to prompts used in production, treating prompts as a first-class engineering artifact rather than an informal, untracked text string. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Prompt Versioning.
